//: Copy to native.config.json (gitignored) or set the matching env vars. All keys are OPTIONAL -- with none set, the build syncs devtools-frontend into native/.devtools and builds from there.
//cxxDebuggingSrc: Path to an existing synced devtools-frontend/extensions/cxx_debugging (with third_party/llvm). When set + present, the sync step is skipped.
//devtoolsCheckout: Where to `fetch devtools-frontend` if cxxDebuggingSrc is not provided (default: native/.devtools).
